key_findings: ESPN carries NO tennis match statistics - verified across ~4800 rows. Schedule/results spine only.
Match Charting Project is the reachable deep-stats layer: point-level serve/return/rally splits per set.
Surface Elo is the primary predictor; clay/grass specialists diverge 100-200 points from overall.
Break points converted is the noisiest common stat - near-random year to year. Shrink hard.
Tiebreak and deciding-set records are almost pure noise beyond serve quality. Use as prior, not signal.
For over/under games, CLOSENESS matters more than level: near-equal Elo -> OVER, large gap -> UNDER.
Tiebreak yes/no is almost entirely combined hold percentage.
Best-of-5 amplifies the favourite's edge - the same Elo gap should price shorter than in Bo3.
odds_note: The Odds API is the only genuine free tier: 500 credits/month, and /v4/sports plus /v4/sports/{sport}/events cost ZERO credits. API-Tennis ($40/mo) and Goalserve ($150/mo) have no free tier. API-Tennis's bookmaker list does NOT include Betwinner.
